source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top Enhancement parses
summary: Stormstrike on 8s cooldown, weave Earth Shock between melee swings, Lightning Shield maintained. Windfury Weapon on main hand, Flametongue on off-hand. Shamanistic Rage for mana/cooldown management.
_dev_note: Wrong-expansion guard (do NOT surface to users): Lava Lash and Maelstrom Weapon are WotLK abilities and are not in this profile's rotation; mention kept here only as an internal reminder.

Chain Lightning.note: AoE spell - heavy single-target use is a significant DPS loss vs melee + shocks

Chain Heal.note: healing during a DPS parse - indicates emergency or wrong role

Lightning Bolt.note: caster spell - Enhancement DPS comes from melee, not spellcasting; heavy LB use means out of melee range or wrong spec

breakpoint.note: Stormstrike is the signature Enhancement ability - it should appear every 8 seconds. Earth Shock should weave between melee swings on a consistent timer. The bulk of Enhancement DPS is from white hits (melee auto attacks) empowered by Windfury Weapon procs, which don't show as casts in the log - a low spell cast count is normal and correct.

advisory: Windfury Weapon (main hand) is the core DPS mechanic - it must be on the MH weapon. Expose Weakness procs on hits and reduces the target's armor, providing significant raid DPS contribution that doesn't appear in your personal damage. Bloodlust/Heroism is the Enhancement shaman's biggest raid cooldown. Shamanistic Rage provides both a DPS burst and mana restoration - use it on cooldown. Fight notes: keep Flame Shock rolling on single-target tank-and-spank, but on movement-heavy fights (Vashj phase 2, Kael adds, Hydross transitions) expect uptime to suffer - reposition to stay in melee for Windfury rather than chasing shock timers. On add-heavy pulls (Karathress catfish, Council, trash packs) Chain Lightning becomes worthwhile cleave; otherwise stay on melee + Earth Shock for single-target.
